title: A missing trial image is provisioned on the spot, not refused
description: With a stub docker first on PATH and the trial image graphyard-trial:local absent, two heads the merge writer trials together wait on one provision — the published image's pull, then a build when the pull fails — and both then run their trial. With the build failing, neither head gets a verdict or a rework, and master status shows one attention line naming graphyard-trial:local and the docker error.

steps.name: a missing trial image is provisioned once for two trials; a failed build is a trial-host fault with one attention line
